headline: On October 17, 1989: East German Politburo ousts Honecker
captionCards: Honecker led East Germany for 18 years until 1989
His ousting paved the way for the Berlin Wall's fall
instagramCaption:
Erich Honecker loses his grip on power. \\[Erich Honecker, the long-time leader of East Germany, was removed from his position as General Secretary by the East German Politburo. Honecker had led the country since 1971, maintaining close ties with the Soviet Union. His removal marked a significant shift in the political landscape, just weeks before the fall of the Berlin Wall. This event signaled the end of his dictatorial rule and the beginning of a new era for East Germany. \\Why do you think Honecker's removal was so crucial? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
